description.value: Ba Le Deli & Bakery is a family-owned Vietnamese delicatessen that has been baking its own French baguettes and crafting bánh mì sandwiches in Vancouver since 1987. The Broadway location is one of several across Metro Vancouver, offering a broad menu of sandwiches, vermicelli bowls, and drinks at street-food prices. Its long-standing community reputation and quick-service takeout format make it a practical and flavourful mid-ride food stop on East Broadway.
